verification: Every value below was checked on 2026-11-15 against the arXiv abstract (or for Lambda_1.4 the arXiv HTML full text, Sec. III) of the cited paper via WebFetch.

J0740_mass.quantity: pulsar gravitational mass from relativistic Shapiro delay
J0740_mass.why_not_used_separately: Both NICER J0740 analyses used this radio mass as an informative prior, so it already enters through J0740_nicer; multiplying it again would double count.

J0348_mass.quantity: pulsar gravitational mass from white-dwarf spectroscopy + radio timing
J0348_mass.model_dependence: depends on white-dwarf atmosphere/mass-radius models; EOS-independent

J0030_nicer.quantity: joint mass and equatorial radius from X-ray pulse-profile modelling (NICER)
J0030_nicer.model_dependence: hot-spot geometry model, atmosphere model, instrument response; the two teams differ in these choices
J0030_nicer.correlation_treatment: Riley and Miller analysed the SAME NICER data: equal-weight mixture, never a product
J0030_nicer.approximation: product of independent split-normals in M and R (M-R correlation ignored)

J0740_nicer.quantity: joint mass and equatorial radius from NICER (+XMM-Newton) pulse-profile modelling with radio mass prior
J0740_nicer.model_dependence: hot-spot model, atmosphere, cross-calibration with XMM-Newton; mass prior from Fonseca et al. 2021
J0740_nicer.correlation_treatment: Riley and Miller analysed the SAME data: equal-weight mixture, never a product
J0740_nicer.approximation: product of independent split-normals in M and R (M-R correlation ignored)

source.authors: B. P. Abbott et al. (LIGO Scientific and Virgo Collaborations)

GW170817_Lambda14.quantity: tidal deformability of a 1.4 M_sun neutron star, Lambda_1.4
GW170817_Lambda14.interval: 90% credible, common-EOS analysis (linear expansion of Lambda(m) m^5 about 1.4 M_sun)
GW170817_Lambda14.model_dependence: waveform model; common EOS for both stars; EOS-insensitive relations
GW170817_Lambda14.approximation: split-normal in ln Lambda_1.4 with 90% bounds mapped to +-1.645 sigma; posterior used as likelihood
